drift.finding: Router source and runtime OpenAPI agree on all 60 application operations. Runtime also registers GET+HEAD for /docs, /docs/oauth2-redirect, /openapi.json, and /redoc; FastAPI intentionally excludes those four paths from the schema.

After normalizing /api/v1 and path-parameter spelling, specs/001-core-text-to-sql/contracts/openapi.yaml has 35 operations and runtime has 60. Runtime has 25 current-only operations; static has zero normalized-only operations.

Runtime responses declare only 200/201/204/422. Thirty operations have an empty 2xx schema; five JSON bodies are generic additionalProperties objects. Implemented 302/400/401/403/404/409/429/500/502/503/504 outcomes are not declared; SSO redirects and audit downloads are misrepresented as generic 200 responses.

The query router says the static openapi.yaml is the source of truth for union results, but the static artifact omits every Phase 6 route and several Phase 3/5 operations. backend/scripts/update_openapi_phase5.py is a manual historical mutator, not a runtime generator.

The Phase 3 contract says connection health/introspection runs asynchronously after create; ConnectionService.create awaits automatic introspection before returning. Treat as current-contract drift, not a coverage gap by itself.

backend/tests/integration/test_sessions.py claims in-flight cancellation in its module description, but no assertion starts or cancels in-flight work and the DELETE implementation only performs database deletion/cascade.
Phase 6 T-801/T-802 names POST /query/{id}/execute, but no such route is registered. Execution quota is implemented inside QueryService.submit_question before its source execution.

Older admin-settings material refers to X-Admin-Key. Current source uses session permission admin.connections.manage; the legacy key remains only on POST /admin/refresh-schema. This is superseding contract evolution, not automatically a gap.
No /health or /ready route exists. docker-compose.dev.yml has dependency healthchecks but none for backend; scripts/dev-up.sh waits for container state only.
